correctness.rationale: Conditional parent uniformity gives exact expectations of all-depth and leaf-depth generating polynomials, and a mixed covariance recurrence with base C_2=0. Solving by a polynomial product yields the claimed exact identity for all complex z; the removable z=-1 case is checked. Fourier inversion yields residue covariance, and Gamma ratios with dominant conjugate roots prove the q=3,4,>=5 modulus threshold, nonzero amplitudes, and infinitely many opposite signs for every fixed residue. Independently exhaustive finite parent sequences through n=9 pass 58 exact-rational polynomial/identity cases and 352 finite Fourier checks. Infinite claims rest on the proof, not enumeration.

value.rationale: Leaf number measures terminal branching while depth-residue counts measure cyclic generation structure. Their genuinely mixed covariance exhibits a sharp cross-classification: decaying oscillation at modulus three, persistent bounded log-oscillation at four, and amplified oscillation at larger fixed moduli. Its boundary differs from the established six-class variance boundary of depth residues. This is a motivated structural dependence phenomenon, not a substitution in the older scalar leaf/path-length identity, and the exact finite-n polynomial makes the phase mechanism reproducible.
